instruction: Candid medium full shot of a woman in a light blue pajama set (R1) and a man in a white t-shirt and blue pants (R2) holding hands while jumping on an outdoor bed. The woman (R1) is on the left, facing right, holding the man's hands as she bounces. The man (R2) is on the right, facing left, holding her hands with a joyful expression. They jump together on a white mattress set in a pine forest. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating a gentle, playful atmosphere with natural green and white tones.
